markers.name: Soki
says: Soki> <sigh> "I am soooo hot! I just want to cool down but I am scared of the deep water, you see. I think this fountain is just perfect for me!"
Soki> "Not yet... shhh... they are watching... they just told me to get out. No, don"t taunt me you little glistening pool of refreshment... I can"t... resist..."
Soki> "Every day after work I come here to cool off, but everyday some damned guard pulls me out and gives me a fine. I ask you, what is water for if not to swim in?"

markers.name: Grarth
says: Grarth> "I"ll wait for you "til I turn blue, there"s nothing more a man can do. Don"t get your bollocks in a twist -- settle down don"t take a fit!"
Grarth> "Ya drank with daemons straight from hell, they almost nearly won as well! Ya wiped the deck in victory, then finally puked until ya fell asleep!"
Grarth> "Toast to tears of times" past glories, this ageless clock chime stalls. Where to kiss a love forgotten, so drink and drink and drink and drink and drink and drink and FIGHT!!"

markers.name: (HC - Access Extender) Kip - Trendor Guard
says: Kip - Trendor Guard> "I got a mean streak three feet wide."
Kip - Trendor Guard> "Don"t give me any trouble. You won"t like my bad side."
Kip - Trendor Guard> "I like to press wild flowers when I"m not blowing holes in murderers."

markers.name: (HC - Access Extender) Josh - Trendor Guard
says: Josh - Trendor Guard> "Is this a stick-up? You know I"ll take you down. Don"t even think about it."
Josh - Trendor Guard> "You don"t know what speed is until you"ve challenged me. You don"t know what pain is until you"ve lost to me."
Josh - Trendor Guard> "I"m what they call a peace keeper. I keep watch, and rip murderers to pieces."

markers.name: (HC - Access Extender) Duliet - Trendor Guard
says: Duliet - Trendor Guard> "Sometimes behind the brightest smile lies the darkest demon."
Duliet - Trendor Guard> "How fast do you think I can move? I"ll bet I"m faster than that."
Duliet - Trendor Guard> "I am watching for murderers entering the city. They check in, but they don"t check out."

markers.name: (HC - Access Extender) Lorella - Trendor Guard
says: Lorella - Trendor Guard> "The creatures that attack the park are generally harmless unless you provoke them."
Lorella - Trendor Guard> "I am not harmless towards murderers. I drop them like moldy fruit."
Lorella - Trendor Guard> "By the time they see me, it"s already too late."

markers.name: (Pillar) Training
says: "Different weapons deal damage in different channels: Normal, Water, Fire, Air, Earth, Relic, Rune, and Death."
"All creatures have weakness to different channels of damage."
"While training, be sure to pay close attention to what type of damage is strongest against which creature types."

markers.name: Snitch Taji
says: [Snitch Taji] "Psst, I hear that there"s a hidden portal around here that goes to Amphibious Island."
[Snitch Taji] "I"m deeply troubled about all the crime, so don"t hold your breath waiting for a hint to its location"

markers.name: Master Leep
says: Master Leep] "Freedom is not worth having if you are not free to fail."
Master Leep] "You cannot serve two masters; either you will love the one and hate the other, or you will be devoted to the one and despise the other."
Master Leep] "The wise talk because they have something to say; fools, because they have to say something."

markers.name: Non"ur Bi"dnez
says: Non"ur Bi"dnez: "I wonder how Plank"l got permission to build his project."
Non"ur Bi"dnez: "Even though Plank"l likes to call it the Boomtown Express, I hear others call it Plankl"s Folly."
Non"ur Bi"dnez: "Now I"m kicking myself for not finding him when I first "arrived""

markers.name: Information
says: Did you hear the latest news? Everybody has been granted citizenship! We don"t have to stay in this festering home of beggars and safezone-snipers called BoomTown anymore!
There"s a robot of some sort in Black Market that might give you some equipment, if you do something for it.
I"ve heard that there are some quests coming, they"re supposedly related to the end of the world or something.
